analysis.summary: GNA Axles Limited reported a revenue of Rs 1,478.42 Cr and Profit After Tax of Rs 116.99 Cr for the financial year 2025-26. Management noted that while overall revenue dropped by around 4% due to export pressures from US tariffs, domestic demand remained robust, especially in the tractor segment. The company advanced its sustainability initiatives by increasing rooftop solar capacity and expanding its product scope through its subsidiary GNA Mobility Limited. Furthermore, the board recommended a dividend of Rs 3 per equity share for the year. GNA Axles Limited reported net revenue from operations of `1,539.74 Cr and a net profit after tax of `107.12 Cr for the financial year 2024-25.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post lower single-digit growth in the current year.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

guidance.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25 onwards.
guidance.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW.
capex_expansion.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capex_expansion.claim: GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary in 2025 to expand into a broader range of automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: A 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its solar capacity further in 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for the year stood at 13.68%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 3,882,041 rear axle shafts in 2024-25.
The company sold 327,019 other shafts in 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of Rs 3 per equity share.
The total CSR expenditure for 2025-26 was Rs 309.99 Lacs.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its solar capacity further in 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.
